title: Organize and Interpret Data
description: Sort and tally objects, build and read picture graphs, compare categories, and collect real survey data.
learningFocus: Organize data into up to three categories, represent it with tally tables and picture graphs, and answer questions about totals, category counts, and how many more or fewer.
adultGuidance: On the graphing pages, reinforce that one picture or colored box represents one vote. For the final survey, your child may ask 1 to 10 people; help them total the three counts, and accept both fruit names if two categories tie for the most votes.

seo.title: Organize and Interpret Data | Grade 1 Worksheets
seo.description: Five printable Grade 1 data worksheets for tally charts, picture graphs, comparisons, and a hands-on survey.
